Attuned: (Alune) changes moon phase after the strongest Alune casts; the lower half of the cycle gives team Durability and the upper half gives team Damage Amp.
Avatar: (Lux) counts her origin twice. Owning an Avatar on the board or bench converts subsequent shop Avatars to that origin.
Apex Predator: (Elder Dragon) uses two team slots and contributes two Riftbeast counts.
Bounty Seeker: (Draven) offers a bounty; only the strongest Draven advances it. Completing it pays its reward and offers another bounty.
Caustic: (Kog'Maw) damage applies both Sunder and Shred, reducing Armor and MR.
Emerald Aspect: (Taric) allows pairing an ally by dragging it onto the strongest Taric; the paired ally receives ability benefits.
Flora Fatalis: (Fiddlesticks, Soraka) grants Mana on takedown; at two units, additionally heals the ally with the lowest Health.
Greenfather: (Ivern) gains seeds from the strongest Ivern's casts and combat rounds, spending them to create beneficial board hexes.
Monolith: (Malphite) gains Armor and MR for each enemy targeting it.
Old Growth: (Maokai) permanently increases the strongest owner's max Health when enemies die within its star-dependent radius.
Rival: (Kha'Zix, Rengar) normally functions with only one Rival fielded. Takedowns progress their distinct rewards; defeating another Rival gives three credit. Kha'Zix can permanently select Executioner, Rapidfire, Ravager or Spellweaver. Rengar earns gold and eventually team AD. Unrivaled enables both together.
Thornmaiden: (Zyra) supplies team Durability, doubled while at least six Zyra plants are alive.
